assumptions.statement: Official GIS/CAD site and key-area polygons are not supplied in the current upstream main. Submitted site and key geometries are explicitly provisional constraints: official_boundary=false, geometry_role=provisional_constraint, boundary_precision=provisional_rough.
assumptions.impact: No official redline, precise site-area, ownership, road-redline, statutory control, engineering feasibility or approved-implementation claim is made. Recalculate all nine GeoJSON layers, topology, areas, ratios, lengths, figures, PDFs, HTML and all boundary-dependent narrative when trusted official geometry arrives.

assumptions.statement: The three key-area polygons are rough, area/order-fitted organizer constraints rather than verified station-, road-, parcel- or ownership-anchored boundaries.
assumptions.impact: Key-area detailed design is directional only; its spatial carrier diagrams must not be read as surveyed site placement or approved development.

assumptions.statement: FAR, total floor area, building height, statutory density, statutory green ratio, setbacks, road redlines and parcel/ownership controls remain unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Generated functional partition and conceptual footprints are not statutory controls or approved massing; professional planning, survey, heritage, property and regulatory verification is required.

assumptions.statement: No verified building survey, heritage-control map, municipal capacity, energy capacity, cooling demand, water condition, noise baseline, heat-recovery arrangement, investment or approved construction schedule is supplied.
assumptions.impact: All corresponding metrics remain unknown; figures show proposed relationships rather than measured or existing conditions.

assumptions.statement: No site visit, instrument measurement, simulation, vendor test, service deployment, user study or human professional review was performed for this package.
assumptions.impact: The three industrial protocols and all thresholds are proposed evidence gates only. No performance, environmental, accessibility, safety, economic or public-acceptance result is claimed.

assumptions.statement: Service, data, facility, accessibility, public-realm-restoration and procurement roles are proposed responsibilities rather than commitments by named institutions.
assumptions.impact: No government, university, company, operator, procurement, funding or international-cooperation commitment is claimed.

assumptions.statement: Every public AI service must retain a non-AI equivalent and cannot be phone-only or screen-only; no biometric surveillance, persistent tracking, personal profile, social score or automated eligibility/medical/legal/enforcement/planning decision is allowed.
assumptions.impact: A service lacking its human fallback, privacy boundary or exit/restoration action fails the proposed entry gate.

assumptions.statement: The current three key-area polygons are retained without independently moving their coordinates. They are only announcement-order and approximate-area fitted containers, with no station, road, parcel, heritage, ownership, or existing-building anchor.
assumptions.impact: Directional plans show sequence, conflict separation, and reversible modules within containers only. Official polygons require re-calculation of every geometry layer, metric, figure, PDF, HTML, and boundary-dependent narrative.

assumptions.statement: International and domestic precedents are used only as comparative mechanisms. They do not establish Beijing facts, approvals, partnerships, legal applicability, engineering feasibility or performance.
assumptions.impact: If a required local condition is absent, the proposed mechanism returns to ordinary service, a prior safe configuration, or a future professional study rather than being implemented by analogy.

assumptions.statement: H1, H2 and H3 are authored conceptual handoff labels located only within provisional key-area containers.
assumptions.impact: They are not stations, buildings, land parcels, operational gates, permits or surveyed locations; their geometry and relationships must be recalculated with trusted official and existing-condition information.

assumptions.statement: Stable public base, replaceable service infill and maintainable equipment pack are design-intent layers for conceptual modules.
assumptions.impact: They are not structural, fire, utility, procurement or disassembly specifications; absent later professional evidence, modules remain undeployed concepts and ordinary public-space uses prevail.
